signature: Three gutted decks of the collapsed car park that was Emstable: rubble and girder poles, rusted 1950s car husks, shopping trolleys, shacks of wood and mined concrete, tents that still hold the dead, a deck fallen into a ramp, and deep mining holes down to Level 23 and up through the roof to Level 21.

exits.label: Dropped down a deep mining hole toward the ceiling of Level 23
exits.method: Reverse of the post-collapse hole entrance (method not detailed)
exits.source_quote: Level 22 can be exited by using the previously mentioned entrances
exits.hint: The deepest of the mining holes, on the lowest deck.
exits.implemented_as: fall trigger inside the open mining shaft below deck A (the page's Level 23 entrance is holes in that level's ceiling)

exits.label: Climbed a rope up through a hole in the roof toward Level 21
exits.method: Reverse of the post-collapse hole entrance (method not detailed)
exits.source_quote: Level 22 can be exited by using the previously mentioned entrances
exits.hint: Grey light falls through a hole in the top deck's ceiling.
exits.implemented_as: rope (LadderVolume) up through the roof hole above deck C; fires once you are two metres up the rope (the page's Level 21 entrance is holes in that level's floor)

exits.label: Pushed through a rusted car husk and no-clipped
exits.source_quote: successfully noclipping through cars or debris can lead to Level 817
exits.hint: Some of the wrecks feel thinner than they look if you keep pushing.
exits.implemented_as: noclip trigger on one car husk on deck B (hold against it for 3 s); added from data/canon/transitions.json

entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE. The page names none; the dead in the tents are only implied (sleeping bags, an examine line).
notes: SOURCE: an infinite, average-looking 20th-century multi-storey car park with parked cars and shopping trolleys, discovered 1925; Emstable micronation from 1987, sealed by 1990, trade with the M.E.G. (2012) and B.N.T.G. (2016); caste of families, each floor passing a fraction upward; top floor lavish (Wi-Fi, pool, football table, cookers), floors 10-15 from the top tents and shacks of wood or mined concrete and a few cookers, below the 16th floor starvation and sleeping in the open; collapse from societal flaws and concrete mining/scavenging; now rubble and girder poles, rusty dusty 50s car husks, abandoned tents with corpses (more on lower floors), countless deep mining holes, climbing them heavily unadvised with recorded deaths; the 'Hilda' diary; the Floor 10 census (floors 1-28, material designations). Exits: the post-collapse holes back to Level 21 (above) and Level 23 (below), and noclipping through cars or debris to Level 817 (CONDITIONAL; added from transitions.json as L022>L817#3). Arrivals: Level 1 glass doors and Level 69 exit ramps ('your car parked in a parking space'). ADAPTATION: the slice is three walkable decks (labelled Floors 8, 9 and 10 with their census designations) under a broken roof, 64 x 48 m with an 8 m grid and 3.0 m floor to floor; collapse rubble chokes the edges and the decks visibly carry on into the dark ('large parts of the level are inaccessible'); the hole exits use a fall into a deep shaft and a rope through the roof (the page does not detail the method); the stair core and the fallen deck ramp are ours; the trip and falling-debris mechanics express the page's unstable footing; the top-floor pool, football table and Wi-Fi are not in this slice (and are never functional). Canon: docs/canon/levels/L022.md; author credited there under CC BY-SA 3.0. Not yet PLAYABLE.
